title: 第17章 赠刀求追读求收藏求月票推荐票第18章 比试求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
苏牧对于武道修炼几乎是一无所知的小白。
他练伏波刀法，也是一个人摸着石头过河，从来没有人给过他什么指点。
昨夜他跟黑龙寨三当家交手，当时就发现对方的力量远超常人，或许就是跟这淬体法有关。
“淬体法……嗯，你肯定没了解过。”
孙大招道，“咱们平素所说的武者大人，那就是指淬体入了门的，淬体四境，皮、肉、筋、骨。
淬体法只是统称，淬皮、淬肉、淬筋、淬骨，都是淬体法。”
“武陵城四个外城里，能传淬体法的势力屈指可数，咱们猎帮就是其中之一。”
孙大招有些骄傲地说道，“怎么样？要不要加入猎帮？
就你这打猎的手艺，加上我帮忙，我有把握让你学到淬体法。
这要是换了其他势力，你想学淬体法，起码得先效力四五年才有可能。”
苏牧心头微动。
差役的路子不好走，要不要换条路？
不过混帮派似乎没什么前途，就算猎帮帮主也是白身啊。
就在苏牧犹豫不定地时候，忽然一阵急促的拍门声响起。
孙大招对苏牧使个眼色，这才走到门口，把门拉开。
“堂主，你怎么来了？”
孙大招脸上露出招牌笑容，微微弓着身子道。
“新的任务，有个叫苏牧的猎户，邢捕头点了名，找到他，送到南城司去。”
那堂主并未进门，直接在门外吩咐道，“我记得他是你管辖的，去把他找来吧。”
说罢，那堂主便匆匆离去。

孙大招脸上的笑容渐渐僵硬，他慢慢地转过身来，目光落在苏牧身上，眼神中浮现出无奈之色。
“要不，趁着还没人知道，你偷偷跑吧。”
孙大招脸上露出挣扎的神色，犹豫着说道。
“我跑了，你怎么办？”
苏牧有些意外地说道。
“你跑了我能有什么办法？找不到人也不是什么了不起的大罪。”
孙大招说道。
“孙爷，你的好意我心领了。”
苏牧摇摇头，说道，“不过我不能跑。”
好不容易才换到武陵城的户籍，逃走的话，那就又得变成流民了。
“你小子——”
孙大招有些急了，“你知道留下的后果吗？
南城司定会驱使你们去攻打黑龙寨，你以为攻打黑龙寨跟打猎一样？
会死人的！”
“我知道。”
苏牧叹了口气，说道，“但是逃走的话，南城司也不会放过我的，与其变成通缉犯，还不如留下搏一搏，万一呢？”
content_en:
Su Mu was a novice who knew almost nothing about martial arts training.
When he practiced the Fubo Sword Technique, he was crossing the river by feeling the stones by himself, and no one had ever given him any guidance.
Last night he had a fight with the third master of Black Dragon Village, and he discovered that the opponent's strength was far beyond that of ordinary people, perhaps it was related to this body tempering method.
"The body tempering method...well, you must not have understood it."
Sun Dazhao said, "The master martial artist we usually refer to refers to those who have entered the Body Tempering Sect, the four realms of Body Tempering, skin, flesh, tendons, and bones.
The body quenching method is just a general term. Skin quenching, meat quenching, tendon quenching, and bone quenching are all body quenching methods. "
"There are only a handful of forces in the four outer cities of Wuling City that can teach the body tempering method, and our hunting gang is one of them."
Sun Dazhao said with some pride, "How about it? Do you want to join a hunting gang?
With your hunting skills and my help, I am confident that you can learn the body tempering method.
If it were another force, if you wanted to learn the body tempering method, you would have to serve for at least four or five years before it would be possible. "
Su Mu's heart moved slightly.
The road of the police officer is not easy to follow. Do you want to find another way?
However, the mixed gang seems to have no future, even the leader of the hunting gang is white.
Just when Su Mu was hesitating, there was suddenly a rapid knock on the door.
Sun Dazhao winked at Su Mu, then walked to the door and opened it.
"Master, why are you here?"
Sun Dazhao's signature smile appeared on his face, he bowed slightly and said.
"The new mission involves a hunter named Su Mu. Capt. Xing named him, found him, and sent him to Nancheng Division."
The hall master did not enter the door, but directly ordered outside the door, "I remember that he is under your jurisdiction, go and find him."
After that, the hall master left in a hurry.
The smile on Sun Dazhao's face gradually stiffened. He slowly turned around and his eyes fell on Su Mu, with a look of helplessness in his eyes.
"Otherwise, you can run away secretly before anyone knows."
Sun Dazhao said hesitantly with a struggling look on his face.
"I ran away, what should you do?"
Su Mu said somewhat unexpectedly.
"What can I do if you run away? It's not a big crime if you can't find someone."
Sun Dazhao said.
"Master Sun, I appreciate your kindness."
Su Mu shook his head and said, "But I can't run."
It took a lot of effort to change the household registration in Wuling City. If he escaped, he would have to become a refugee again.
"You kid——"
Sun Dazhao was a little anxious, "Do you know the consequences of staying?
Nancheng Secretary will definitely drive you to attack the Black Dragon Stronghold. Do you think attacking the Black Dragon Stronghold is the same as hunting?
It will kill people! "
"I know."
Su Mu sighed and said, "But if I escape, Nancheng Division won't let me go. Instead of becoming a wanted criminal, why not stay and give it a try? What if?"
